title: NASA Reconnects with Voyager, Longest Serving Mission in History
summary: 1977 онд хөөрсөн Voyager сансрын хөлгүүдтэй NASA дахин холбоо тогтоосон нь.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from NASA.

questions.prompt: What is this story mainly about?
options: NASA fixing communication problems with Voyager
NASA building two new spacecraft to replace Voyager
NASA ending the Voyager mission later this year
questions.explain: NASA "has once again reconnected with its Voyager spacecraft" гэж эхэлж, холбооны асуудлуудыг хэрхэн засаж байгааг өгүүлсэн.

questions.prompt: How long does it take to receive data from the Voyagers?
questions.explain: "Its communication with the two Voyagers takes about one day to receive data" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: Why have the Voyagers worked for so long, according to Suzanne Dodd?
options: The engineers built in many backup systems
The spacecraft were repaired by astronauts
The spacecraft stay close to the sun
questions.explain: "The engineers who built them provided multiple backup systems" гэж Додд хэлсэн.
